scenarios.prompt: Define a time-trial race with stable route/checkpoint validation, tie rule, restart policy and ghost collision policy independently from handling.

criteria.structure: Race ID/revision defines ranking, route validity, finish and optional catch-up/item policy.
criteria.ownership: Vehicle response stays in racing-feel; network/RNG/QA stay with their owners.
criteria.evidence: Race outcome is explainable from structural state rather than presentation.
